newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Premier Lien Chan to step down in July; lawmaker Vincent Siew likely to become new cabinet chief.
President Lee Teng-hui and Governor James Soong meet.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Opposition parties threaten to boycott President Lee Teng-hui's keynote address in National Assembly.
LIBERTY TIMES - Premier Lien says he will step down once constitutional reforms are completed.
Ruling Nationalist Party to prevent opposition parties' bid to raise a motion to sack Lien.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Government-related funds to buy shares in bid to stabilise the stock market.
Taiwan dollar falls sharply, but central bank says no need to intervene.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Political crisis shocks financial markets.
U.S. dollar's sharp depreciation trend stabilises.
